notes.zh: 错误码（crates/protocol/src/lib.rs Error）：5 Encoding、6 Arithmetic、7 Amount、8 Slippage、9 Invariant、10 Authorization、11 Structure、12 Capacity、13 Token、14 Genesis。所有 syscall 失败经 sys() 映射为 11 Structure。
notes.en: Error codes (crates/protocol/src/lib.rs Error): 5 Encoding, 6 Arithmetic, 7 Amount, 8 Slippage, 9 Invariant, 10 Authorization, 11 Structure, 12 Capacity, 13 Token, 14 Genesis. Every syscall failure is mapped to 11 Structure by sys().

notes.zh: 没有销毁池的路径：state type 要求同 type 输出恰好为 [0]，池一旦创建只能继续更新。全交易只允许一个 state 输出（同 code_hash），所以多个池不能在同一交易中更新。
notes.en: There is no pool-destruction path: the state type requires same-type outputs to be exactly [0], so a pool can only be updated after creation. Only one state output (same code_hash) is allowed per tx, so several pools cannot be updated in one transaction.

notes.zh: LP token = xUDT（code_hash 0x50bd…1b95、data1），args = hash(role 1 state lock) ‖ 00000000；铸造依赖 xUDT owner 模式（state cell 在输入中）。XUDT_CODE_HASH 写死在协议 crate 中。
notes.en: LP token = xUDT (code_hash 0x50bd…1b95, data1), args = hash(role 1 state lock) ‖ 00000000; minting relies on xUDT owner mode (the state cell is an input). XUDT_CODE_HASH is hard-coded in the protocol crate.

notes.zh: 部署：README 明确说明仓库不含部署配置、交易构造器或 CKB-VM 集成测试；未找到官方 code_hash，因此本页 match 为空、无测试交易。plugin 在 JS 中重算 apply（已用协议单元测试的数值核对），并标注余额与 reserve 布局为未检查。
notes.en: Deployment: the README says the repo contains no deployment configuration, transaction builder or CKB-VM integration tests; no official code_hash was found, so match is empty and there are no test txs. The plugin recomputes apply in JS (cross-checked against the protocol unit-test values) and marks balances and reserve layout as not checked.
